definitions.gloss: one-person company; sole-member corporation; single-owner business entity
definitions.explanation: A legally incorporated company where a single individual serves as the sole shareholder, director, and often the only employee. Distinct from sole proprietorship in that it is a registered corporate entity with limited liability.

examples.japanese: フリーランスから{一人会社|ひとりがいしゃ}に{変|か}えた。
examples.english: I changed from freelancing to a one-person company.

examples.japanese: {一人会社|ひとりがいしゃ}を{設立|せつりつ}すると、{節税|せつぜい}のメリットがある。
examples.english: Establishing a one-person company has tax-saving advantages.

examples.japanese: {一人会社|ひとりがいしゃ}でも{法人|ほうじん}として{社会保険|しゃかいほけん}に{加入|かにゅう}する{義務|ぎむ}がある。
examples.english: Even a one-person company has the obligation to enroll in social insurance as a corporation.

notes:
Composed of {一人|ひとり} (one person) and {会社|かいしゃ} (company). Since the 2006 revision of Japan's Companies Act, it became possible to establish a {合同会社|ごうどうがいしゃ} (limited liability company) or {株式会社|かぶしきがいしゃ} (corporation) with just one person, making {一人会社|ひとりがいしゃ} increasingly common among freelancers and consultants.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {一人会社|ひとりがいしゃ}を{設立|せつりつ}する: to establish a one-person company
- {一人会社|ひとりがいしゃ}の{経営|けいえい}: managing a one-person company
- {一人会社|ひとりがいしゃ}のメリット: advantages of a one-person company

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {個人事業主|こじんじぎょうぬし}: sole proprietor — an individual running a business without incorporating
- マイクロ{法人|ほうじん}: micro corporation — a very small incorporated business, often used interchangeably with {一人会社|ひとりがいしゃ}
- {合同会社|ごうどうがいしゃ}: limited liability company (LLC) — a common corporate form chosen for one-person companies due to lower setup costs
